title: R' Avin Zutrati
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin records that he reports in the name of R' Yehudah bar Zevina, citing Berakhot 12b. Our reading is Rabbi Abbahu bar Zutrati; Dikdukei Soferim reads, “Rabbi bar Zutrati said.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The quoted reading is “Rabbi bar Zutrati said,” not “Rabbi said, bar Zutrati.” No omitted forename is supplied.

The checked Berakhot 12b paragraph names Rabbi Abbahu ben Zutrati reporting Rabbi Yehudah bar Zvida. Hyman’s Avin heading and bar Zevina wording, and the reported Dikdukei Soferim “Rabbi bar Zutrati said,” remain distinct source forms. No missing forename or equivalence of the named figures is supplied. R’ in the heading and reported Zevina clause preserves Hyman’s abbreviated title.
